name: Jiniya Addons
author: jiniyaaddons

sections.description:
Jiniya Addons is a simple and flexible Elementor addon designed to create beautifully crafted team member sections.
This plugin provides a clean and modern team widget for Elementor users, allowing you to showcase team members with:

  • Profile Image
  • Social Icons
  • Name
  • Designation
  • Description

This plugin works only with Elementor Page Builder.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Find Jiniya Addons inside Elementor widgets under the category Jiniya Addons.
  5. Drag & drop the widget into your page and start customizing.
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor?

No. This plugin is an addon of Elementor and requires Elementor Page Builder installed.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! It works perfectly with any theme that supports Elementor.

Is there any shortcode?

No. This is an Elementor widget only.
